03 Custom origin

The Awakening

I thought the sun was just something above me Then I realized it was something inside me
FunnyLoyalBrave CompetitiveProtectiveRebellious OptimisticEmpatheticConfident

Before the powers Caio Da Costa lived a life that felt completely normal to him He loved football and music and spent most of his time with people who made him feel like he could become anything


Caio was ambitious but he was never perfect He could be stubborn when someone challenged him and he hated being told that something was impossible Underneath the confidence was a kid who secretly worried that his dreams were bigger than his chance of reaching them


Then came the day everything changed


A violent solar event turned the sky strange and brilliant Caio felt heat rush through his entire body Instead of burning him the energy disappeared into him His skin became dark like living shadow and golden light began moving beneath it


When he woke he could feel energy everywhere Sunlight felt like food Electricity felt like a distant voice His heartbeat seemed to move with the heat of the day


Caio was terrified at first He did not understand what was happening and he had no idea how much energy his body could hold But when someone he cared about was in danger his fear disappeared


That was the moment Sunspot was born

Born From Light

A custom character book

Born From Light

This custom book follows Caio Da Costa before he ever calls himself Sunspot His story is inspired by the spirit and origin of Roberto Da Costa while remaining its own story built specifically for this character

Caio grew up in Brazil surrounded by family ambition football music and the pressure to become something great He was confident loud competitive and stubborn but underneath all of that he cared deeply about the people closest to him

Football became his escape Whenever life felt too complicated Caio could step onto a field and forget everything else He loved the heat of the afternoon the noise of the crowd and the feeling that for a few minutes nothing existed except the game

But Caio had always felt that there was something strange about himself He could stay outside under the hottest sun longer than everyone else He sometimes felt stronger after spending the day outside He thought nothing of it and never imagined that those small details were signs of what was coming

One afternoon during a heated match everything changed A violent burst of solar energy crossed the sky while Caio was caught in the middle of the game The heat became overwhelming His body suddenly felt like it was being filled with fire

Caio dropped to his knees as darkness spread across his skin and a strange golden glow began moving through his body The people around him could only watch as the energy gathered around him

He tried to scream but the sound disappeared beneath the roar of energy His fear turned into confusion and then into something completely different

For the first time Caio felt the sun inside him

That was the moment his mutation awakened The story ends there Before the costume before the name before the hero there was only Caio standing in the light realizing that his life would never be the same

08 Deep Cut Character Files

Sunspot Facts

Little details that make Roberto feel like a person instead of just a power set

01

Brazilian Roots

Roberto Da Costa is Brazilian and that background is an important part of how he is written His identity and family history give him more depth than his powers alone

02

Original New Mutant

Sunspot is one of the original New Mutants and has repeatedly returned to that team and its story across different generations

03

Solar Battery

His body can absorb solar energy and use it to enhance his physical abilities while also producing powerful energy attacks

04

Flight

When he has enough stored energy Sunspot can fly which turns his solar power into both offense and mobility

05

Not Just A Fighter

Roberto has grown into roles involving leadership strategy business and responsibility His story is about learning how to use influence as well as power

06

Confidence Has Layers

His outward confidence can hide uncertainty That contrast is one of the most useful parts of his personality for serious roleplay

07

Avengers Connection

Roberto eventually became a major part of the Avengers side of the Marvel universe and took on leadership responsibilities far beyond his early New Mutant days

08

Power Has A Cost

The interesting part of Sunspot is not simply how strong he can become It is whether Roberto can stay himself when the pressure keeps increasing

09

Modern Mutant Leader

His later stories place him among experienced mutant characters dealing with much larger questions about mutant society survival and the future

10

Perfect RP Conflict

His confidence his temper his loyalty and his uncertainty can all exist at once which creates room for conflict without turning him into a completely different character

11

Light Changes Him

When his powers are active his appearance becomes visibly altered which makes his transformation feel like a real part of the character rather than a simple costume change

12

Growth Is The Point

The best Sunspot stories let Roberto evolve He can be arrogant reckless funny scared loyal brilliant and heroic without losing the core of who he is

09 The People Behind The Fire

Love And Loyalty

Roberto is at his best when the people around him matter His relationships give his confidence his temper and his courage a reason to exist

01

Sam Guthrie

Sam is one of the people Roberto trusts most Their friendship grew from their time as New Mutants and became one of the most important bonds in his life Roberto can argue with Sam and still know that Sam will be there when it matters

02

Danielle Moonstar

Roberto respects Dani because she understands the weight of being responsible for other people She has seen his worst moments and still treats him like someone capable of becoming better

03

Illyana Rasputin

Illyana is part of the strange family Roberto found among the New Mutants Their history is filled with danger arguments jokes and impossible situations Roberto cares about her because she understands what it means to survive things that should have broken you

04

His New Mutant Family

Roberto loves the people he grew up fighting beside because they became more than teammates They challenged him protected him called him out and gave him a place where being different did not make him alone

05

Juliana Sandoval

Juliana represents one of the deepest emotional wounds in Robertos story She stood beside him when his mutation first appeared and sacrificed herself to save him Her memory is tied to his guilt his determination and his promise to become stronger

06

Nina Da Costa

Roberto has a complicated family history but his connection to his mother matters Nina represents the part of his life that existed before the superhero world took over and she helps remind him that he is still a son before he is Sunspot

10 The Heat Has Targets

Enemies

Roberto does not dislike people simply because they are strong His biggest conflicts usually come from people who threaten mutants manipulate the people he loves or try to control his choices

01

Donald Pierce

Pierce represents one of the earliest reasons Roberto learned that his powers could make him a target His actions against Roberto and Juliana turned fear into anger and helped push Roberto toward the New Mutants

02

Selene

Roberto has every reason to distrust Selene She is manipulative powerful and willing to use peoples emotions against them Her attempts to control Roberto strike directly at his need to make his own choices

03

Gideon

Gideon represents betrayal on a personal level He presented himself as someone Roberto could trust before using him for experiments that dramatically increased his solar abilities Roberto has every reason to see him as someone who treated a person like a resource

04

Shadow King

The Shadow King is exactly the kind of enemy Roberto hates most He attacks through manipulation and control rather than simply fighting fair For someone who values his freedom that kind of threat is deeply personal

05

Sentinels

Sentinels represent the fear and hatred that mutants have had to survive Roberto sees them as machines built around the idea that people like him should be hunted instead of understood

06

The Hellfire Club

Robertos relationship with the Hellfire Club is complicated because of his family history and his own time around its power structure He dislikes the manipulation and elitism but has also learned that sometimes getting close to dangerous people can be a way to fight them from inside

The people he loves are the reason he fights The people who try to control them are the reason he burns hotter

RP History

I have been playing games and roleplaying on Roblox for most of my life I mostly play anime superhero and RPG games I like playing characters with existing stories because it is fun to act like the actual character I have been in multiple RP servers so I understand the importance of staying in character not metagaming following rules and not ruining RP for others I understand RP is about giving other players a chance to have fun and have their own moments

Why I Want To Play Sunspot

I want to play Sunspot because I think Roberto Da Costa is a very interesting character with a lot of potential I like how he is a powerful mutant who can absorb solar energy and use it to increase his strength and abilities At the same time Roberto is not just someone who uses his powers to fight everyone He has his own personality emotions and struggles that make him more interesting to roleplay

I like that Sunspot can be confident and determined while still caring about the people around him I would show his personality instead of making him focused only on fighting His powers and connection to the X Men could also create interesting RP situations with other mutants and heroes

Why I Should Be Chosen

I think I would be a good choice because I care about portraying Sunspot correctly I will not make him act like a completely different character just because it is easier or funnier I want to keep his personality lore abilities and actions accurate while making RP enjoyable for everyone

I understand that having a powerful character does not mean I should try to win every situation or make everything about myself I would give other players chances to interact with Sunspot and have their own moments I would also avoid metagaming powergaming and forcing RP onto others Overall I want to create good RP situations contribute to the server and make sure everyone is having fun

Sunspot Lore And RP Philosophy

Sunspot is a character built around passion and instinct and I think that energy only works if the story lets him actually burn hot His arc shouldnt be flattened just to make him predictable Sometimes its better to let his temper and his growth show through actions and let the players see him make mistakes and come into his power over time

One thing I really care about is the small details that make a world feel real I want to respect the canon thats already there like his time with the New Mutants and his ties to Brazil and Roberto Da Costa becoming Sunspot in the first place Id rather build from those details than change them just because its more convenient for the story

I also want the people around him to actually feel the difference he makes His teammates should see him as someone who fights harder than anyone when it counts while people who dont know him yet might see him as reckless or hot headed Both sides should make sense from their own point of view instead of one just being made right for the sake of the story

At the end of the day I wouldnt see continuing this lore as something that belongs to me Its something the community has built together and Id want to respect that while giving other players room to add to it

FUN FACTS
ROBERTO DA COSTA CHARACTER FILE
01

Real Name And Origin

Roberto Da Costa is a wealthy Brazilian mutant first introduced in Marvel Graphic Novel 4 in 1982 as a founding member of the New Mutants

02

Powers

He absorbs solar energy which gives him superhuman strength durability and flight and turns his skin black while he is powered up which inspired the name Sunspot

03

Rich Kid Turned Hero

Roberto comes from serious money and his family wealth repeatedly becomes part of his story including his connection to Da Costa Enterprises and later corporate ventures

04

Leadership Roles

He has led the New Mutants and X Force and has also become connected to the Hellfire Club and the Avengers through his own wealth and influence

05

Solar Power Quirks

His powers become stronger when more sunlight is available and he can be weaker at night or in poor conditions which has led him to use technology and solar charged equipment

06

Screen Appearances

Sunspot has appeared in X Men animated stories and was featured in The New Mutants film where the character was played by Henry Zaga

07

Temper

Early Roberto struggled with a hot temper and impulsiveness which made him one of the more emotionally volatile New Mutants and gave his solar powers an interesting reflection of his personality

08

First Activation

His mutant powers first manifested dramatically during a soccer match as a teenager after an opposing player used a homophobic slur against a teammate and Robertos rage triggered his mutation

09

Team Up With The Devil

Roberto once made a literal deal with Amahl Farouk also known as the Shadow King to save his fathers life and the consequences followed him into darker parts of his story

10

X Force Era

Under Cables leadership Sunspot became a more ruthless militant operative which showed a much harder side of Roberto compared with his earlier New Mutant years

11

Illuminati Member

Roberto was invited into a version of the Illuminati which reflected how far his influence had grown beyond simply being a young mutant hero

12

Avengers Idea Mechanics

In one of his wildest eras Roberto became the director of AIM after buying the organization and using it to help fund a black ops Avengers team

13

Cosmic Power Ups

Roberto has reached dramatically amplified levels of solar and cosmic power in certain stories temporarily pushing his abilities into extremely high power tiers

14

Relationships

He has had a long on again and off again romantic history with fellow New Mutant Amara Aquilla also known as Magma and has developed important bonds with other teammates

15

Name Origin Joke

Sunspot is a funny name because real sunspots are darker cooler areas on the sun rather than sources of extra heat but the name became perfect for the visual of Robertos powered form

16

Depowered Arc

Like many mutants Roberto lost his powers after M Day during House of M which forced him to experience life and leadership without the abilities he had built his identity around

17

Multiple Costumes

His look has changed dramatically across the decades from his early headband era to sleeker armored and technology based designs during his later X Force and AIM stories
